name: Renoised Score Distillation (RSD)
definition: A score-distillation objective for 2D image resolution that combines features from ancestral sampling and SDS to generate sharp images that are also LR-consistent.
summary: Renoised Score Distillation is a score-distillation objective for 2D image super-resolution that optimizes in intermediate latent timesteps to produce sharper details than standard SDS while maintaining better low-resolution consistency than ancestral sampling.
